postal_system.assignment_rule: Correos de Costa Rica and the April 2009 UPU addressing sheet use five digits: one province digit, two canton digits and two district digits. The UPU national-addressing case study states that each district received a postcode based on official administrative numbering. Syntax, an INEC DTA code, district name or historical UPU example is not proof of the current assignment, exact civic address, internal 19-digit delivery point, building relation, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: District alignment makes deterministic polygon derivation possible, but not automatic. A polygon is official-derived only when a pinned current Correos assignment observation and an exact versioned INEC or IGN district code and geometry form a one-to-one, time-compatible, rights-cleared crosswalk with topology, CRS and digests verified. INEC UGED geometry deliberately differs from some imaginary DTA limits; SNIT, OSM, Voronoi, buffers, interpolation, API caches and model surfaces cannot be presented as operator-issued postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, street, house number, neighborhood or locality, exact directions, landmark, premises or building, floor, apartment or unit, P.O. Box, province, canton, district and postcode separately. A directional description may be necessary but does not establish a coordinate or building. Synthetic fixtures contain no real Correos or UPU result, address, delivery point, building, organization or person.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as administrative_district_postcode, routing_area, delivery_point_19_digit_internal, po_box, organization or unknown. The internal 19-digit delivery-point identifier described by UPU is not public data and must not be reconstructed from a five-digit postcode, address or coordinate.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed explicit relation to a permitted building identifier and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, release, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. Postcode, district, parcel, landmark, exact-directions text, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: INEC DTA identities and codes, INEC UGED geometry and IGN or SNIT layers are contextual evidence with distinct legal and geometric meanings. Pin producer, edition, code, boundary type, officiality, CRS, licence and crosswalk; do not relabel geostatistical or administrative geometry as Correos-issued postal geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted operator observations and rights-cleared geospatial releases may normalize input, perform strict code joins, validate or enrich candidates, compress reviewed geometry, detect drift and produce mathematical or machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source and service version, request and input digests, observed_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and authoritative, official-derived or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, fills unknown coverage, manufactures official geometry or infers a house number, unit, building, organization, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound Costa Rican assignment observations, typed postal objects, permitted district geometry, rights-cleared civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative context to AGID cells without relabelling a district or source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Costa Rican postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Correos interactive service and UPU publications are not blanket open bulk-data licences. INEC resource-level reuse status must be confirmed and pinned before redistribution. SNIT general conditions prohibit commercial use of direct or derived geographic information, so SNIT is reference-only unless separate written rights apply. ODbL material remains separately attributed and partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO CR scope and records terrestrial, island, water, border, province, canton, district and source-specific coverage explicitly. Postal, administrative, statistical, geostatistical, cartographic, cadastral, civic-address, building and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and vintage remain independent.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact civic addresses, directional descriptions, landmarks, apartments, coordinates, access points, parcels, organizations, P.O. Boxes, operator responses, credentials and query logs can expose sensitive household, property or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; never bundle people, occupants, owners, account secrets or the operator's internal delivery-point identifiers.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments, operator observations, the April 2009 UPU sheet, the UPU policy case study, DTA editions, the INEC UGED 2024 release, IGN or SNIT layers, legal terms, community data, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, source version, service version, release, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with source licence, release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted Correos, UPU, SNIT, cadastral, delivery-point or address inputs remain private, gated or external according to their terms. Dataset Viewer is discovery and preview, a Space is a demonstration surface, and production AGID services must pin a Hub commit and verify artifact digests. Generated district-postcode polygons remain derived review surfaces until promotion checks pass.

stages.definition: Postal authority, geometry candidates, object classes, identity, privacy and rights gates are inventoried.
Costa Rica-specific assignment, district-geometry, rights, temporal, non-area and AGID authority contracts are reviewable without production data.

A complete pinned current Correos de Costa Rica assignment observation and an exact current INEC or IGN district Polygon/MultiPolygon release form a reviewed one-to-one crosswalk, or an explicitly dated and typed alias crosswalk, for every drawable five-digit code. Resource-level terms must permit AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public area serving; exact receipts, editions, dates, CRS, digests, topology, exceptions and a reproducible no-fabrication transform must be fixed. The real AGID API and application must normalize a code, return the real official-derived geometry with source date, class and confidence, fit and render translucent fill plus clear outline, clear and re-search it, and expose loading, no-match, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states. Point, route, P.O. box, organization, address, building, parcel, person, customer, internal delivery point, buffer, hull, cell, model, synthetic fixture or AGID proxy never becomes a postal area.
